title: Site changes opens on People and Tracy with a hidden-automatic line, titles a chat row by its request, and undoes a chat request with the turn engine through one button; rows the engine does not list keep today's actions
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/core/tracy-core/test/site-changes-undo-request.test.mjs
S2: Read the result of each test named below.
expect: 'the list opens on People and Tracy, asked of the server, with the hidden line; Show is Type: All' passes.
'a Chat row is titled by the request, quoted, and says what changed under it' passes.
'an opened Chat row has ONE undo button; the dialog says what goes back; Undo calls the engine' passes.
'an older request: Go back to before this request, scope from-here, the later requests named' passes.
'blocked: the chat card’s sentence with who, what and when, and Ask Tracy to revert; no undo' passes.
'a Chat row the engine lists: no Undo file changes in its menu or its detail, one undo button' passes.
'rows the engine does not speak for keep Undo file changes in the menu' passes.
evidence: Measured 05/10/2026 on cowork.tracy.site: Site changes opened on Type: All with 53,339 events, 99.8% automatic; chat rows read 'Changed N files'; an opened chat row offered Undo file changes (files only) beside Ask Tracy to revert.
fence: The default filter is a server filter (paging stays right), and a chat row the engine lists has exactly one undo path, the same engine and words as the chat card.

tests: the list opens on People and Tracy, asked of the server, with the hidden line; Show is Type: All
a Chat row is titled by the request, quoted, and says what changed under it

rows the engine does not speak for keep Undo file changes in the menu
